entry.name: rnbo_list.ease
entry.digest: Generate impulses for a list of audio values
entry.description: The list.ease object applies an easing function to an input list. This allows you to craft non-linear trajectories, such as a bounce or exponential curve from the output of phasor~ or line , for example.
